annotations.title: Look up possible FDA records for a device

tools.description: Read-only; no model call. Give what you read from a device photo or label (device_name, model, manufacturer, k_number, udi or gtin, product_code; at least one) and get up to 3 possible FDA records from openFDA (510(k), registration & listing, UDI), each with why_matched and why_not_matched, plus this week's change, recent recalls and the report count for the top product code, each with its openFDA link. status is needs_person_to_confirm, no_match_found or search_failed. `confirmed` is always null: a person confirms one record, or none.

device_name.description: Device name as read from the photo or label.

gtin.description: GTIN (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits), if printed without a full UDI.

k_number.description: 510(k) number printed on the label: K plus six digits.

product_code.description: Three-letter FDA product code, if known.
